node.title: Re^7: Creating a whitelist
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [htmanning],

Sounds like the list in the DB is separated by CRLF (Windows style) instead of just LF (*NIX style). Two other ways you could fix it are by writing your [doc://split] as split /\r?\n/, $goodorg; (handles CRLF and LF), and/or by trimming whitespace off each string via $goodorg=~s/^\s+|\s+$//g;.

I find the fastest way to see problems like this is by using [doc://Data::Dumper] with its Useqq option:

use Data::Dumper; $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1; print Dumper($goodorg); __END__ $VAR1 = "Company\r\nLLC\r\n";

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
